lines.Shell: C, C++, CUDA, Python, Rust, Go

processes.title: ElastiCache Core Data-Plane Engine
processes.summary: Working on ElastiCache’s core data-plane engine, owning crash analysis and production deep dives. Mitigated a TLS connection storm by experimenting with and retuning the engine’s connection-queue sizing, and navigated ~400M log lines with agentic AI tooling to root-cause a security vulnerability.
processes.impact: Keeping a managed in-memory database stable at AWS scale by turning production crashes and incidents into root-caused fixes.

processes.title: Legacy Service Rewrite in Rust
processes.summary: Rewrote a legacy service in Rust using an autonomous agentic pipeline, and validated the rewrite by shadowing production traffic before cutover.
processes.impact: Cut per-request latency from ~30s to 700ms and build times from ~8h to 1.5h, saving ~$1,700/yr in licensing.

processes.title: UDV — S3-Compatible Storage Interface
processes.summary: Co-owned UDV, Commvault’s S3-compatible storage interface, end to end, resolving operational pains and bugs. Earlier designed gRPC-based multi-node communication for horizontal scaling, with request routing, inter-node messaging, and caching for GET requests and multipart uploads.
processes.impact: Made S3-compatible storage scale horizontally and run more reliably for critical backup pipelines.

processes.title: Monday.com Backup & Restore
processes.summary: Built backup and restore for the Monday.com platform on Commvault infrastructure, using an agentic AI coding assistant.
processes.impact: Extended Commvault’s data protection to a new SaaS platform.

processes.title: Build Systems & Observability
processes.summary: Owned maintenance and feature development for Bindep, an internal C++ dependency analysis tool. Built health-check endpoints for observability, integrated AI-based log analysis and crash detection, and shipped frontend improvements across a 400K-line React codebase.
processes.impact: Resolved 20+ critical incidents through server log analysis and root-cause remediation, keeping a critical build tool reliable.

processes.title: Cipher Algorithm Detection
processes.summary: Designed an end-to-end cipher detection pipeline with NIST-inspired feature engineering on raw ciphertext. Ran 40+ experiments across XGBoost, LightGBM, CNNs, Transformers, and BERT-style models. Productionized via a C++ feature extractor with ONNX inference achieving ~270ms per file.
processes.impact: Delivered a production ML system for cipher detection (80% accuracy, 0.79 F1) meeting strict latency constraints.

processes.title: MemEvolve — LLM-Evolved Linux Page-Cache Policies
processes.summary: Honors thesis advised by Prof. Michael Swift. Used LLMs to evolve Linux page-cache eviction policies as eBPF, deployed live in a custom cache_ext 6.6.8 kernel via eBPF struct_ops with no rebuild or simulator. Built a breadth-first evolutionary search (planner, mutator, frontier reviewer) driven by kernel-probe feedback, and a distributed evaluator across CloudLab nodes that isolates each candidate in a cgroup.
processes.impact: 18% higher throughput on scan-based workloads, with workload-specialized policies beating cache_ext’s baselines.

processes.title: Course Assistant — OS & AI
processes.summary: Taught systems programming in C: pointers, manual memory management, and concurrency for OS kernel projects. Led 10–15 student system design sessions on copy-on-write, huge pages, RAID, lock-free buffers, and cache coherence, and authored a GDB guide for debugging concurrent kernel-space C.
processes.impact: Mentored 600+ students, resolving 98% of implementation issues. The GDB guide was adopted by TAs for 2 semesters.

processes.title: Full-Stack Fantasy App
processes.summary: Built core Express.js backend services from scratch for a real-time baseball fantasy app. Implemented caching and memoized APIs, translated Figma designs into responsive React interfaces, and improved Git workflows and codebase maintainability.
processes.impact: Reduced API calls per page from 400+ to ~30, significantly improving performance and scalability in a fast-paced startup environment.

processes.title: SmartMigrate — LLM-Powered Asylum Form Filling Agent
processes.summary: Co-founded an LLM-powered legal-tech agent to guide asylum seekers through Form I-589 with context-aware questioning, input validation, and structured output. Built a Next.js frontend and Django backend for LLM orchestration and form data management.
processes.impact: Showed potential to save 50+ attorney hours per case. Won Best Prototype award and successfully pitched to investors.

processes.title: MyTorch — Deep Learning Framework from Scratch
processes.summary: The entire deep-learning stack in C++/CUDA with zero ML dependencies: strided N-d tensors with zero-copy views and broadcasting, a CPU/CUDA dispatch layer, reverse-mode autograd checked against finite differences, nn modules, and a FlashAttention kernel with online softmax and SRAM tiling. Trains a Llama-3.1-style transformer and a UNet diffusion model end to end.
processes.impact: Drove SGEMM from 7.5 to ~63 TFLOP/s (~80% of cuBLAS) on an RTX 5090 in 7 Nsight-guided optimization stages. See the MyTorch Gallery.

processes.title: PrimitiveDB — Cache-Conscious Storage & Joins
processes.summary: A C++ harness benchmarking PAX columnar vs row-major storage and radix vs naive hash joins, measured with perf_event_open(2).
processes.impact: Single-column scans 6x faster with ~14.5x fewer L1D misses; joins 2.7x faster with ~170x fewer L3 misses using a radix-partitioned hash join sized to L1/L2.

processes.title: Office Hours Queue — LLM-Powered TA & Student Support
processes.summary: Led a team of five to build a full-stack queue platform replacing a fragile Google Sheets workflow. Integrated LLMs via Microsoft AI Foundry for AI-assisted Q&A, code diffing, and debugging hints. Used Flask + React (Vite) with Redis caching and Server-Sent Events for real-time updates.
processes.impact: Reduced TA debugging time with LLM-generated diffs and summaries. Replaced a manual process with a scalable system, cutting queue backlogs.
